delta_validation: Replacing only the two uniform initializations/Columns-only assignments with original whole-row assignments recovers exact frozen production bytes.
semantic_reasoning: For every index in unchanged Rows Range, initialization writes Present=True and well-typed SQL_Null columns; loop then writes every named field from the same original SQL(I,J) in the same row order. On normal return each complete row is value-identical to the original assignment.

Pre requires equal first/last row bounds and SQL columns 1..16 or 1..9. It already suffices for every original and replacement index. No new arithmetic, extent predicate, cap, text validation or SQL-cell restriction is added. Null ranges initialize/write zero elements and retain the universal post.

Columns selection is valid after Present=True initialization. Plain record copies have no controlled hooks, access values, type predicates or callbacks. Root/Subject SQL cells including arbitrary valid Null/Integer/Text/Blob/Real values and spans are copied unchanged; projection does not reinterpret them.

Only actual callers pass distinct Value.Root_SQL/Value.Roots or Subject_SQL/Subjects components. Types are value-only distinct array types with no access/address overlays here; output writes cannot alter SQL input. Helper has Global null and no callbacks, so additional intermediate null columns are not exposed to observers or authority decisions.

All typed assignments/indices have the same successful execution domain under original geometry. No new data-dependent exception is introduced by the fixed literal initialization; absence of runtime failure and automatic frame proof still require exact-candidate tool evidence.

Private all-Present posts and all public Decode/DecodeGrown posts are byte-unchanged. Logical preservation of Present through Columns-only updates is the intended modular proof fact, not a claim GNATprove has established it.

cost.source: Additional default writes are one linear pass over row count; unchanged checked post is linear. Columns record temporary is fixed per row. No quadratic checked prefix invariant, dynamic source allocation or input-sized ghost snapshot is added.
cost.limit: This is reviewed OBSERVED isolated compiler output using actual types and checked posts. Whole-array iterated variant had dynamic temporary and is excluded. Integrated resource/deadline adequacy remains unproved.
